scripts.ab:report: wrangler d1 execute sema-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT a.arm, a.assigned, COALESCE(w.converted, 0) AS converted, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(w.converted, 0) / a.assigned, 2) AS pct FROM (SELECT arm, COUNT(*) AS assigned FROM ab_assignment GROUP BY arm) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT variant AS arm, COUNT(*) AS converted FROM waitlist WHERE variant IS NOT NULL GROUP BY variant) w ON w.arm = a.arm ORDER BY a.arm"
scripts.waitlist:list: wrangler d1 execute sema-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT id, email, variant, created_at, referer FROM waitlist ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
